name: Spang-a-lang ride swing
desc: Ride-led swing: spang-a-lang triplet elongation on uzu ride, pedal hat on 2 and 4, feathered kick, rotating euclid snare comping, crash phrase heads.

code.sparse: stack(s("rd [rd@2 rd] rd [rd@2 rd]").gain(".58 [.3 .44] .52 [.28 .4]").lpf(sine.range(3200,5200).slow(32)).pan(.6), s("~ hh ~ hh").gain(${gain}*.38).lpf(2500)).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
code.full: stack(s("rd [rd@2 rd] rd [rd@2 rd]").gain(".62 [.32 .46] .56 [.3 .44]").lpf(sine.range(3500,6000).slow(32)).pan(sine.range(.52,.68).slow(16)), s("~ hh ~ hh").gain(${gain}*.45).lpf(2600), s("bd*4").gain(${gain}*.2).lpf(900), s("sd(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").gain(".36 .22 .3").lpf(2400)).fast(${rate}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
